title: Smoking context and blood eosinophils: a negative cross-cycle lung-function prediction test
abstract: Smoking-context interactions of blood eosinophils did not demonstrate improved cross-cycle prediction of pre-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC beyond flexible additive measurements: weighted MSE difference +0.1696 percentage-points squared, joint PSU-bootstrap95% [-0.1335, 0.7459] (NHANES2007-2008 to2011-2012).
